turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting resistance welding electrode diagnostic and qualification procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the initial electrode inspection. Check the electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than one millimeter or mushrooming, inspect the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage, and examine the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've completed the inspection. The electrode caps show some minor surface wear but no deep pitting or mushrooming. The shank contact surfaces are clean and the coolant ports are clear.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the caps are in acceptable condition with only minor surface wear. No severe damage observed.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The face diameter is below the minimum serviceable dimension. It's worn beyond the acceptable limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Dress the electrode caps to nominal geometry using the electrode dresser.

ground_truth.node_text: Dress electrode caps to nominal geometry using electrode dresser

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Electrode caps dressed. I've restored the face geometry to nominal dimensions.

ground_truth.node_text: Dress electrode caps to nominal geometry using electrode dresser

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: With the cooling circuit running, place an inline flow meter at the cooling water outlet from the electrode holder body. Record the flow rate in liters per minute and compare it against the minimum cooling flow specification for this electrode size.

ground_truth.node_text: With the cooling circuit running, place an inline flow meter or a timed collection vessel at the cooling water outlet from the electrode holder body. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare against the minimum cooling flow for this electrode size in the resistance welding machine specification. Low flow indicates a partially blocked cooling channel or a failing recirculation pump.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Flow rate measured and recorded. Both electrodes are showing flow rates at the outlet.

ground_truth.node_text: With the cooling circuit running, place an inline flow meter or a timed collection vessel at the cooling water outlet from the electrode holder body. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare against the minimum cooling flow for this electrode size in the resistance welding machine specification. Low flow indicates a partially blocked cooling channel or a failing recirculation pump.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both electrodes are showing flow rates above the minimum specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Electrode force within plus or minus five percent of programmed schedule value?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured force from the load cell is within the tolerance band of the programmed value.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Measured weld current within plus or minus three percent of scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the peak current from the test weld is within three percent of the scheduled value.

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Weld time within plus or minus one cycle of scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured weld time matches the programmed schedule within one cycle.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above ninety percent of face area?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the carbon transfer pattern shows concentric, uniform contact covering more than ninety percent of the face area on both electrodes.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all five pilot welds show clean appearance with no spatter, expulsion, or surface cracking.

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the ultrasonic scan shows nugget diameters on all specimens meet the minimum requirement for this material stack.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing interfacial fracture on two of the specimens. The buttons aren't pulling cleanly.

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Revise the weld schedule and increase the heat input incrementally.

ground_truth.node_text: Revise weld schedule, increase heat input incrementally

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Schedule revised. I've increased the current setting by two percent.

ground_truth.node_text: Revise weld schedule, increase heat input incrementally

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The peel test is now passing. All specimens show full button pull with no interfacial fracture.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the schedule file transferred to the server without error and the timestamp is current.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the return line temperature at steady state is above the maximum allowable value.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Check the chiller setpoint and clean the condenser.

ground_truth.node_text: Check chiller setpoint and clean condenser

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Chiller setpoint verified and condenser cleaned. Temperature should stabilize now.

ground_truth.node_text: Check chiller setpoint and clean condenser

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Run twenty consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings. Log the weld current, force, and time for each weld from the controller data output, and inspect the final five spots visually for consistent button size and absence of expulsion.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 20 consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings with the machine in normal production configuration. Log the weld current, weld force, and weld time for each weld from the controller weld data output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion before signing off the qualification record.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Twenty production welds completed and logged. The final five spots show consistent button size with no surface expulsion.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 20 consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings with the machine in normal production configuration. Log the weld current, weld force, and weld time for each weld from the controller weld data output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion before signing off the qualification record.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: All production qualification welds within specification?

ground_truth.node_text: All production qualification welds within specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all twenty welds are within specification for current, force, and time.

ground_truth.node_text: All production qualification welds within specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the electrode data, calibration results, and qualification record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log electrode data, calibration results and qualification record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm trying to log this data but the calibration software keeps throwing a CRC checksum error and won't save the file to the network drive.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All data logged and qualification record signed off.

ground_truth.node_text: Log electrode data, calibration results and qualification record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The resistance welding system is now qualified for production operation.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Acknowledged. Machine ready for production.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
